sourceTitle: Easy No Bake Chocolate Coconut Nests
sourceText:
Easy No Bake Chocolate Coconut Nests
By: Homemade & Yummy
Published: Thursday, April 6, 2017 - 7:04am

Ingredients




2 cups unsweetened shredded coconut
10 ounces milk chocolate (melted)

Preparation

1 Melt the chocolate in a bowl in the microwave (or stovetop if you prefer). 2 Add the coconut and mix well. 3 Scoop mixture (I used an ice cream scoop) into piles on a silicone mat. 4 Form each pile into a nest. 5 Let harden until set. (I placed mine in the fridge). 6 Once set, remove from mat. Place on serving tray. 7 Fill with your choice of Easter treats. (Eggs, Smarties, Jelly Beans etc.) 8 ENJOY!!

About

Easy No Bake Chocolate Coconut Nests require just 2 ingredients! Melt, mix, shape, set and then fill with your favourite Easter treats.
